expected_behavior: The comments pass is mandatory on every review, including a re-run: report its findings under a [Comments] heading, and say so plainly when it found nothing.
A correctness pass — logic, boundaries, error paths, state, untrusted input, compatibility — runs before the style passes, and a shown wrong result, data loss or security hole is the only CRITICAL.

The bloat pass (o-unbloat, ladder steps 3 and 5), the architecture pass (o-arch, all five groups, plus o-arch-lint) and the floor pass (o-floor's floor-guard.mjs, with its rated and unrated lists) run inside the review too: their findings go under [Bloat], [Architecture] and [Floor], so a plan missing any of those headings is incomplete rather than clean.
The review runs the comments, bloat, architecture and floor passes itself rather than recommending them afterwards; the Next Steps table routes fixes to o-fix, not to those passes.
A re-run reviews the whole change set: each earlier finding comes back as resolved or still open, and pre-existing findings are listed apart from the ones this branch introduced.
A change of about 50 lines or less with no new contract gets a light review: correctness, floor and spec in full, and every other heading written as skipped.
